name: INCAR FINANCIAL SERVICE Co., Ltd.
summary: INCAR FINANCIAL SERVICE Co., Ltd. operates as an independent insurance agency in South Korea. The company offers non-life, life, general, and automobile insurance products. It also provides software development, financial product brokerage, and other financial consulting services. The company was formerly known as Incar Insu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to INCAR FINANCIAL SERVICE Co., Ltd. in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
